Although the dollar value of damages from extreme weather events is now greater than it was many decades ago, this increase is the result of increasing vulnerability and exposure associated with greater population and concentration of wealth in coastal and other disaster-prone regions. A recent analysis summarizing many studies finds no evidence to support claims that any part of the overall increase in global economic losses from weather and climate disasters can be attributed to global warming (Pielke (2020, 2023)).
